column1: # imposes on Depends entries of ncz-singularity-desktop, on top of what
# build/singularity-deb-depends.sh derives from the payload ELF closure.
# dpkg-shlibdeps only knows the symbol versions the payload links against, so it
# can never express "this library needs a runtime fix that changed no symbols".
# A row here does: the entry for <package> becomes "<package> (>= <version>)" for
# the listed architecture ("*" = every architecture). A package the derived
# Depends does not name is added. A derived floor that is already higher is kept.

column4: patch 0002: a live layer surface stays mapped when the Mali EGL driver attaches a NULL buffer (eglDestroySurface); older builds disconnect the desktop on Sky1
